rows.text: An old shed stood at the end of the garden.
Its door was locked fast.
A rusty lock held it fast.
A second key lay on the bench.
A flag on the roof hung limp.
Mara longed to get into the shed.
She shoved the door, but nothing happened.
She wondered what the second key did.
She pushed the second key hard, and it slid along the bench.
